summary: The miniature captures a porch-house idea, but the target is not yet strongly recognizable: its massing, veranda, roof composition, and palette diverge too far from the gray-green Christian Science House.

orientation.summary: The sole modeled exterior door is on +v (SE, toward Center Avenue). This agrees with the entrance visible beneath the veranda in located SV3, with supporting oblique context from SV2; the labeled +v render places that door on the same veranda face. No duplicated principal portal appears in the inventory.

issues.problem: The model reads as a long, plain rectangular block with a small end porch, unlike the reference’s compact, irregular house silhouette with prominent intersecting gables.
issues.fix: Reshape the main mass and roof into the recognizable intersecting-gable composition, including the attic-windowed gable ends.

issues.problem: The characteristic two-storey wraparound veranda is reduced and visually concentrated on one narrow end.
issues.fix: Extend the stacked veranda around the visible corner/long facade, using slender posts and railings as the dominant miniature feature.

issues.problem: White walls, sparse trim, and token red stripes miss the gray-green clapboard, pale trim, and clearly projecting muted-red awnings.
issues.fix: Apply the gray-green palette and model readable awning canopies, porch trim, and paired attic windows with slightly exaggerated depth.
